name: grok-studio
description: An agentic Roblox studio for Grok Bot: a Lead bot runs Coding, Designer (UI), Builder (Studio + Blender), Animator, VFX, SFX and Marketing bots that build a complete game from one prompt in your Roblox Studio - spec, Luau code, mobile UI, maps and models, animations, effects, sound, an automated playtest-and-fix loop, icon, thumbnails and launch posts. One setup command creates the team and connects Studio and Blender.
